settings.heading: Private events
settings.text: Host a tasting, after-work drinks, or a client lunch on our all-weather terrace in the City. Enomatics, Coravin, and platters to match the wine. Monday to Friday, 12pm–10pm.

settings.heading: Your table, our cellar
settings.text:
The tasting terrace sits above the shop on St Swithin’s Lane, a short walk from Bank and Cannon Street. We can shape a visit around a tasting flight, a celebration, or a quieter table with Grand Cru by the glass.

Tell us the date, numbers, and how you would like the afternoon or evening to feel. We will come back with availability and a simple plan.
